diagnosis: The admin audit log query takes org_id directly from the query parameters and defaults to unscoped search if omitted or permits querying any org_id. It never enforces AuditLog.organization_id == current_user.organization_id, allowing any tenant admin to inspect security audit trails and user activities of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs?org_id=402&action=api_key.created HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_admin_jwt>
